en.Busca por palavras no caminho, nome exat: Search by words in the path, exact name, exact path, asset name and * or ? patterns. Category, subcategory and chunk filters; multiple types at once; Exclude field with semicolon-separated terms; base files preferred over Type variants.
en.Prévia ao lado da biblioteca sem abrir o: Preview beside the library without opening Blender. Orbit, pan, zoom, frame (F), front and side views. Solid mode or raw base texture. Mesh selector only for assets with multiple meshes; add to queue and close the panel without losing filters.
en.Confirmação persistente após carregar a: Persistent verification after geometry loads. Cache is isolated by installation and mapping and invalidated when source files change. Failures do not confirm an asset. cache/previews is cleared on normal exit; verifications and exports are preserved.
en.Adicionar selecionados ou todos os resul: Add selected assets or all search results, prevent duplicates, remove items and track each export. Hide/show the queue without losing items. Collapsible library without horizontal scrolling. Progress below the description and a red × to cancel.
en.Conversão em GLB e importação no Blender: GLB conversion and Blender import with geometry validation, reports and .blend output. One folder per asset, previous files preserved and filters retained after export. Configurable game, Blender and output folders; the game installation is read-only.
en.Lote específico de GM_Hair_N: prioriza o: GM_Hair_N batch: prefer the base file; if it is absent, select Type variants. The October 8 report records 103 files imported and validated in Blender, including the 002 test copy and the 000 marker.
en.Distribuição portátil com runtime incluí: Portable distribution with bundled runtime, requiring no Git or SDK on the target computer. Open Aion2Porting.exe and keep the support folders beside it. The distributed folder contains no personal exports or caches.
en.Leitura dos índices do jogo, mapping .us: Reads game indexes, .usmap mappings and updated packages. Asset and chunk catalog, inventory, single/batch export, logs and failure reports. Compatibility is verified by testing each model; support for every asset is not assumed.
en.Materiais oferecem uma prévia de cor bas: Base color and optional approximate materials are supported, with compatible skeleton animations. Original Unreal shaders, effects and physics are not simulated. Preparing models for FiveM remains a later step.
en.Materiais aproximados são opcionais. Ani: Approximate materials are optional. Compatible animations can be previewed. Original shaders, full effects and game physics are not simulated. Preparing models for FiveM remains a later step.
